page.title: Account and settings
page.description: Your profile, preferences, access, and data.

sections.preferencesDescription: Defaults for new sessions and how dates are shown.

security.activateHint: Set a password below to turn it on

privacy.exportDescription: A JSON file with your profile, sessions, questions, responses, surveys, insights, and speaking requests you've received.
privacy.deleteDescription: Permanently deletes your profile (including your public one), all sessions, responses, surveys, insights, speaking requests you've received, and participant contact details. This can't be undone.

preferences.timeZoneHint: Used for your sessions' dates and times.
